verses.1: By Solomon, son of David, king of Israel.
verses.2: To know wisdom and to understand the words of prophecy.
verses.3: You have taken justice and fairness from those who are upright and honest.
verses.4: To suddenly give a young man knowledge and wisdom.
verses.5: The wise man will listen, and he will take what is necessary. He will also gather up all the necessary items.
verses.6: To understand the wisdom and teachings of the sages.
verses.7: Fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom and knowledge. It also involves the proper handling of wild animals.
verses.8: Listen, my son, to the teachings of your father. Do not break the laws of your mother.
verses.9: For they are like cherubim for your head, and serpents for your horns.
verses.10: Son, if you commit sins, do not bring them out into the light.
verses.11: If they say to us, “Let us be destroyed by bloodshed,” then let us be purified through sacrifice.
verses.12: They are swallowed up when they are alive and innocent, like branches that fall from a tree.
verses.13: All those treasures were found in our homes. They were filled with wealth.
verses.14: Your glory will be shared among us, like a single bag. It will belong to all of us.
verses.15: Son, do not walk in their ways. Let your feet not be led along by their path.
verses.16: For their feet desire evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
verses.17: For their beauty, they were despised in the eyes of all men.
verses.18: And they shall be filled with joy; they shall rejoice in their hearts.
verses.19: So, every one who does evil deeds will be punished for his own actions.
verses.20: The wise ones, who are far away, cry out in the wilderness.
verses.21: At the entrance to the gates of the city, it shall be called in Hebrew.
verses.22: Until death, they will still love me. They will seek to please me and do what I command them. But the foolish will hate me for my knowledge.
verses.23: Return to my presence. Now, I send you my spirit as a message to you. I speak to you through this message.
verses.24: I called out, but no one heard me. I stretched out my hand, but no one responded.
verses.25: And all my plans failed; I was left without any hope.
verses.26: I too will laugh at you when you are in fear.
verses.27: When fear and anxiety come upon you, it will bring suffering and distress upon you.
verses.28: Then he will call me, but I won’t answer. He will try to harm me, but I won’t be found.
verses.29: For they did not choose to follow the knowledge and fear of Jehovah.
verses.30: Do not follow my advice; let all my efforts be in vain.
verses.31: And they would eat from their own fruits, and they would rejoice with their own decisions.
verses.32: For the return of fools will kill them, and the foolishness of those who are stupid will destroy them.
verses.33: And he who hears me will dwell in safety, and we will be free from fear.
